account.googleOnly: You sign in with Google. You can also set a password.
account.exportBody: Get a copy of everything we store about you, as a JSON file.
account.deleteBody: Your account is closed immediately and your personal data is anonymised after 30 days. Payment records are kept in anonymised form for accounting. This can't be undone.
account.calendarBody: A private link that keeps Google, Apple or Outlook Calendar in sync with your course sessions and live sessions. Join links are never included.
account.calendarNone: You don't have a calendar link yet.
account.calendarResetConfirm: Reset your calendar link? Calendars that use the old link stop updating, and you'll need to add the new one.
account.calendarResetDone: Your calendar link was reset. Add the new link to your calendar app.
account.calendarLastFetched: Last checked by a calendar app: {date}
account.deletedBody: You're signed out and can't sign in to it any more. Your personal data will be anonymised within 30 days. We've sent you a confirmation email.

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.subtitle: The first five steps are required and take about 5 minutes. The rest is optional but helps us shape courses for you.
onboarding.doneBody: Your profile is ready. Next, browse courses and apply.
onboarding.invitedNote: You were added to a course: you don't need a complete profile to join it. Finish these steps now or later.

profile.title: My profile
profile.coreMissing: Complete the required details before you can apply to a course.
profile.reviewPrompt: It's been a while since you updated your profile. Is it still accurate?

sectionHints.core: Required before applying to any course.
sectionHints.professional: Required. Helps instructors pitch sessions at the right level.
sectionHints.skills: Rate yourself honestly; this is only used to plan courses and cohorts.
sectionHints.goals: Tells us which courses to build next.
sectionHints.links: Required: your LinkedIn and GitHub profile links.
sectionHints.community: Required: your Telegram and Discord usernames, and a Yes or No for each question. Nothing is chosen for you, and you can change your answers any time.

fields.phoneHint: With country code, e.g. +201001234567. In Egypt you can also type 01001234567.
fields.timezoneHint: Detected from your device. Session times are shown in this timezone.
fields.googleEmailHint: Used to give you access to paid-course recordings on Google Drive. It must be a Google account (Gmail or Google Workspace).
fields.acceptTerms: I am 18 or older and accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.
fields.productionTools: Tools and platforms you've used in production
fields.productionToolsHint: Type and press Enter, or pick a suggestion. Up to {max} characters each.
fields.interestedTopics: Topics you'd like future courses on
fields.referralSource: How did you hear about us?
fields.communityMember: I'm a member of the community Discord or Telegram
fields.shareWithPartners: Share my profile with MLOps MENA hiring partners
fields.shareWithPartnersHint: Only your profile is shared. Your CV is shared only if you uploaded one. We share only with partners we vet, and you can turn this off at any time.
fields.marketingEmails: Email me about new courses and events
fields.telegramUsernameHint: Your username, not your phone number: 5–32 letters, digits or _ (the @ is optional). Find it in Telegram → Settings.
fields.discordUsernameHint: Your username, e.g. layla.ml (an older name#1234 works too). Find it in Discord → User Settings → My Account.

handlesBanner.title: Add your Telegram and Discord usernames
handlesBanner.body: Course groups and community help happen on Telegram and Discord, so we now ask for both. Nothing changes for your current courses; you'll need them before your next application.

dashboard.noneInProgress: No course in progress right now.

catalog.title: Courses
catalog.metaDescription: Live, cohort-based courses on MLOps, LLMOps, Kubernetes and AI engineering, taught by practitioners from the MENA region.
catalog.subtitle: Live cohorts taught by practitioners. Free community courses and paid deep-dives, in Arabic and English.
catalog.emptyAll: No courses yet. Check back soon.
catalog.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
catalog.enrolled: {count, plural, =0 {No students enrolled yet} one {# student enrolled} other {# students enrolled}}

course.fullInstant: Seats are full: you'll join the waitlist.
course.scheduleNote: Times are shown in your timezone ({tz}).
course.screened: Applications are reviewed; seats are limited.
course.paidNote: Paid by InstaPay or Vodafone Cash after you're accepted. See the {refund}.
course.recordingsNote: Every lesson of this cohort, free to watch.
course.noRecording: No public recording for this lesson.

apply.fullInstant: This course is full. If you apply now, you'll join the waitlist and we'll email you if a seat opens up.
apply.fullReviewed: All seats are taken right now. You can still apply: if the team accepts you, you may be placed on the waitlist until a seat opens up.
apply.title: Apply: {course}
apply.intro: Answer a few questions so the instructors can shape the cohort. Your profile details are included automatically.
apply.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address before applying. We sent a link to {email}.
apply.profileFirst: Complete the required parts of your profile (basics, professional background and education) before applying. It takes about 5 minutes.
apply.closed: Applications for this course are closed.
apply.already: You've already applied to this course.
apply.profileNote: Your current profile is attached to this application. Check it's up to date.
apply.googleNote: Paid recordings are shared with your Google account: {email}.

errors.ALREADY_APPLIED: You've already applied to this course.
errors.COURSE_CLOSED: Applications for this course are closed.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address before applying.

applications.withdrawHelp: Can't take part after all? Withdraw so your seat can go to someone on the waitlist.
applications.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw your application to {course}? Your seat goes to someone else. You can apply again while applications are open.
applications.withdrawUnderReview: Your payment is being verified. To withdraw now, contact the team: see the refund policy.
applications.title: Application

next.SUBMITTED: We're reviewing your application. You'll get an email when the status changes.
next.SHORTLISTED: You're shortlisted. We'll confirm your place soon.
next.AWAITING_PAYMENT: You're accepted! Complete the payment to confirm your seat.
next.PAYMENT_SUBMITTED: Your payment proof is being verified, usually within 2 working days.
next.PAYMENT_REJECTED: Your payment couldn't be verified. Please submit a new proof of payment.
next.ENROLLED: You're enrolled. Session links and recordings are on the course page.
next.REJECTED: This application wasn't accepted. We hope to see you in a future course.
next.WAITLISTED: You're on the waitlist. We'll email you if a seat opens up.
next.WITHDRAWN: You withdrew this application. You can apply again while applications are open.

payment.step1: Send exactly {amount} using one of the methods below.
payment.step2: Keep the transaction reference number from the receipt.
payment.step3: Upload a screenshot of the confirmation and fill in the details below.
payment.driveNote: Course recordings will be shared with your Google account: {email}. Make sure it's correct before paying.
payment.policyNote: By paying you agree to the {terms} and the {refund}.
payment.transactionRefHint: As shown on your InstaPay or Vodafone Cash receipt.
payment.screenshotHint: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB. Only academy admins can see it, and it's deleted after 180 days.
payment.submitted: Thanks! We're verifying your payment, usually within 2 working days.

errors.NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT: This application isn't waiting for a payment.
errors.GOOGLE_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Add your Google account email to your profile first.
errors.FILE_TYPE: Upload a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file must be 5 MB or smaller.
errors.FILE_REQUIRED: Upload a screenshot of the payment.
errors.PAYMENTS_NOT_CONFIGURED: Payment details aren't available yet. Please try again later.
errors.METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE: This payment method isn't available. Choose another one.

payment.notConfigured: Payment details aren't available yet. Please check back soon.

payments.title: Payment review
payments.verifyWarning: Verify this reference and amount in the actual InstaPay / Vodafone Cash transaction history before approving. Do not approve based on the screenshot alone.
payments.screenshotDeleted: Screenshot deleted by the retention policy.
payments.linkExpires: This link expires in 5 minutes and the view is logged.
payments.verifiedCheckbox: I verified this reference and amount in the transaction history

dashboard.funnelNote: People per step, each step counted on its own: people can skip steps (for example, signing in instead of registering), so no step is a share of the one before.

apps.title: Applications
apps.reason: Feedback for the applicant (optional, shown in their rejection email)
apps.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. We were looking for more hands-on production experience. Consider the recordings and apply to the next cohort.
apps.ownApplication: This is your own application. Another admin decides on it, so you can’t change its status.
apps.noProfile: No profile data: it was removed when the account was anonymised.
apps.cvHint: CV uploads were removed from the profile, so only students who uploaded one before have a CV.
apps.viaAdmin: Enrolled directly by the course team

students.title: Students directory
students.subtitle: Every registered student, not only applicants.
students.readOnly: Profiles are read-only for admins. Use internal notes.

courses.title: Courses

inv.title: Enrol by email
inv.help: Add people to this course directly, without the application form or a complete profile. Accounts that already exist are enrolled now; anyone else is invited and enrolled automatically once they sign up and confirm the same address (or sign in with Google).
inv.emailsHint: Separate them with commas, spaces or new lines. "Name <email>" works too.
inv.orCsv: Or upload a CSV file: email, then optionally name and note.
inv.fileTooLarge: That file is too large (500 KB at most).
inv.fileEntries: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in {name}
inv.nothing: Add at least one email address.
inv.tooMany: At most {max} addresses at a time. Split the list.
inv.languageHint: For addresses without an account. People with an account get emails in their own language.
inv.sendEmailHint: Enrolled students get a "You've been added" email and invited addresses get an invitation with a sign-up link. Everyone enrolled also gets an in-app notification.
inv.paidBody: Enrolling by email skips the application and the payment: these people get a seat without paying, and nothing is recorded under Payments.
inv.skipPaymentRequired: Tick "Enrol them without payment" to continue.
inv.capacity: Seats: {taken} of {capacity} taken. Enrolling {count, plural, one {# more person} other {# more people}} goes over capacity: direct enrolment doesn't check it.
inv.doneEmailed: {count, plural, one {# email} other {# emails}} queued.

outcomeHint.ENROL: Has an account: enrolled straight away.
outcomeHint.INVITE: No account yet: enrolled once they sign up and confirm this address.
outcomeHint.INVITE_UNVERIFIED: Has an account that hasn't confirmed its email: enrolled once it does.
outcomeHint.ALREADY_INVITED: Waiting for them to sign up. Resend the invitation from the list below.

inv.listEmpty: Nobody has been added by email yet.
inv.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation for {email}? They won't be enrolled when they sign up.
inv.retention: Invitations that are never used are deleted after 180 days.

fields.levelsHint: Who the course is for. Pick one or more; none means all levels.
fields.levelProgression: Show as steps up (e.g. "Mid to Senior · Senior to Lead")
fields.levelProgressionHint: For a course that takes people from each picked level to the next one.
fields.preparationHint: Shown right after the prerequisites, e.g. setup steps. Leave empty to hide.
fields.externalPlatformHint: The platform it ran on, if not the academy. Leave empty if it ran here.
fields.externalUrl: Link to it on that platform
fields.publicRecordings: Recordings are public: shown on the course page and in the Recordings library once each lesson has ended
fields.showEnrolledCountHint: The course page and its cards say how many students are enrolled (the number only, never names).

courses.driveWarning: Share this folder ONLY with enrolled students' Google accounts. Never use "Anyone with the link": one student could forward it to everyone.
courses.driveChecklist: In Drive → Share → Settings (gear), turn OFF "Viewers and commenters can see the option to download, print, and copy".
courses.avg: Average {avg} ({count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}})
courses.deleteSession: Delete "{title}"? Students’ progress and feedback for this session are deleted too. This can’t be undone.
courses.instructorShared: Instructors are shared: changes show on every course they teach.

weekly.title: Add weekly sessions
weekly.help: Creates one session per week at the same local time. Rename each session afterwards.
weekly.skipHint: Week numbers with no session, e.g. 4 for a break week.
weekly.liveUrlHint: You can set a different link per session afterwards.
weekly.create: Create {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}

duplicate.help: Copies the content, questions, sessions and instructors into a new draft. Not copied: applications and students, the course dates, Drive folder and playlist, and every session link and material (Meet, recordings, assignments, quizzes). Update the session dates afterwards.
duplicate.slugTaken: Another course already uses this slug.

courses.topicsHint: Shown publicly on the course page. Don’t put links or private details here; use the link fields and materials instead.

ann.title: Send an announcement
ann.help: An email and an in-app notification to everyone whose application has one of the chosen statuses, e.g. the study-group link, quiz links or a schedule change. Students who were deleted are skipped.
ann.arHint: Optional: the English text is used when empty.
ann.confirm: Send this announcement to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}? It can’t be undone.
ann.sent: Sent to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. Emails go out over the next few minutes.

delete.confirm: Delete "{title}" permanently? Its sessions, questions and announcements are deleted too. This can’t be undone.
delete.hasApplicants: "{title}" has applicants or students, so it can’t be deleted (their records must be kept). To archive it instead (it disappears from the catalog and applicants can no longer reach it), type its slug: {slug}

courses.pastCohortHint: For a cohort that has ended (status Completed): the course page stays public with its recordings, and nobody can apply.
courses.importedHint: Added by the archive import. Your edits are kept: the import never changes a course after an admin edits it or its sessions.

wl.title: Waiting list
wl.help: Students who pressed "Notify me" on the course page. Joining needs an academy account; entries marked "No account" joined before that and are kept. Nobody is emailed until you send the message below.
wl.notifyHelp: Emails everyone not told yet, with a button to the course page and a link to leave the list. Students with an account also get an in-app notification. People without an account get a version that asks them to create their academy account to apply, with a sign-up link for their address. People who were already told are not emailed again.
wl.notOpen: You can notify the list once the course is open for applications: set its status to Open in the Details tab. Nothing is sent automatically.
wl.confirm: Email {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} now? It can’t be undone.
wl.sent: Queued for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. Emails go out over the next few minutes.
wl.empty: Nobody is on the waiting list yet.
wl.filterEmpty: Nobody on the list matches this filter.
wl.openPrompt: The course is open and {count, plural, one {# person on its waiting list hasn’t} other {# people on its waiting list haven’t}} been told yet.

apps.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, job title or company

fromBooking.title: Draft course from a speaker booking: not in the catalog yet.
fromBooking.body: Prefilled from the booking, with the speaker as instructor. Add the Arabic title and description (module titles start in English), check the details, then set Status to Open or Coming soon and save to publish.

courses.learnAccessHint: Every enrolled student can open the course’s learn page, quizzes and assignments.

settings.title: Settings
settings.liveLinkRevealMinutes: Show live links this many minutes before a session
settings.screenshotRetentionDays: Delete payment screenshots and CVs after (days)
settings.placeholderWarning: No payment method is set up yet. Students can't pay until you add InstaPay or Vodafone Cash details.

hints.instapayHandle: Leave empty to stop offering InstaPay.
hints.vodafoneCashNumber: Leave empty to stop offering Vodafone Cash.
hints.supportEmail: A real, monitored inbox. Shown on the contact and policy pages and in payment help. Empty: those pages point to the community channels.
hints.supportWhatsapp: International format, e.g. +20 100 123 4567. Shown in payment help and on the contact page. Empty: hidden.
hints.speakerCancelDays: 0 lets speakers cancel right up to the start.
hints.sessionTeamEmails: Each address gets its own email when a speaker books or cancels a slot. Never shown publicly.

settings.speakerMaxOpenBookings: Upcoming bookings one speaker can hold
settings.teamEmailsEmpty: No addresses: nobody will be emailed about speaker bookings (admins still get an in-app notification).

sessions.title: Live sessions
sessions.intro: Free standalone sessions: talks, workshops and open Q&As. Published sessions appear on the public Live sessions page.
sessions.speaker: Speaker

fields.coSpeakersHint: People besides the main speaker, in the order shown on the session page. Each needs a speaker profile.
fields.liveUrlHint: Required to publish. Shown only to registered people, shortly before the start.
fields.statusHint: Cancelling, or changing the time of, a published session emails everyone registered.
fields.topicsHint: Comma-separated, for the Recordings filter, e.g. docker, ci-cd, model-serving.
fields.categoryHint: Its shelf in the recordings library: the filter chips on /sessions/recordings.
fields.speakerProfileHint: Links the session to the speaker's page. Fields left empty below are filled from the profile.
fields.recordingUrlHint: Paste the YouTube link once the session has ended: it then shows on the session page and in the Recordings library.

sessions.hasRegistrations: People registered for this session, so it can't be deleted. Set its status to Cancelled instead: everyone registered gets an email.
sessions.importedHint: Added by the archive import. Your edits are kept: the import never changes a session after an admin edits it.
sessions.kindDetailsHint: Filled by the speaker when booking, or by you. Every field is optional; empty ones don't show on the public page. Course here is only a label on the session: a speaker's course booking becomes a draft course in Courses.
sessions.bookedBy: Booked by {name} through the speaker portal.
sessions.courseBookingHint: Make it a draft course you finish and publish in Courses. It's prefilled from the booking, with the speaker as instructor.
sessions.courseLinked: This booking already has its course ({status}).

publish.title: Draft: not visible on the public sessions page.
publish.ready: Everything it needs is filled in. Publish it to put it on the public sessions page.

need.liveUrl: The live link (the Google Meet link)

publish.savedDraft: Saved as a draft: it's not on the public sessions page yet. Press Publish when it's ready.
publish.published: Published. It shows on the public sessions page within about 2 minutes. A speaker who booked it is emailed the link.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.intro: Course instructors and live-session speakers. Everyone with a published session or a public course has a page at /speakers/{slug}.
speakers.importedHint: Added by the archive import. Your edits are kept: the import never changes a speaker after an admin edits it.

fields.slugHint: Leave empty to make one from the name.
fields.titleHint: Optional: leave empty when you don't know it (the page then shows the name only).
fields.linkedinHint: Required. Their linkedin.com profile; tracking parameters such as ?utm_source=… are removed when saved.
fields.photoHint: An https:// link, or an image on this site such as /speakers/name.webp (400px or smaller).
fields.bioHint: Optional for a one-off speaker: the page then shows their name, title and sessions.

speakerApps.title: Speaker applications
speakerApps.intro: People who signed up as speakers. Approve to create or link their public speaker profile and let them book a slot; reject with a note they can act on. They're emailed either way.
speakerApps.noteHint: Required to reject. The speaker reads it in the email and on their page.
speakerApps.linkProfileHint: Leave as is to create a new profile from this application, or link an existing one (e.g. a past speaker).
speakerApps.approvedDone: Approved. The speaker was emailed and can book a slot now.
speakerApps.rejectedDone: Rejected. The speaker was emailed your note.
speakerApps.profileHint: Edit the bio, Arabic name and photo there. The page goes live with their first published session.
speakerApps.accountHint: One role per account. Speakers use the speaker portal and can also apply to courses and study; switch the account if they'd rather only study (or speak).
speakerApps.toStudentConfirm: Switch this account to a student account? They'll lose access to the speaker portal.
speakerApps.toSpeakerConfirm: Switch this account to a speaker account? They'll use the speaker portal and keep their courses: speakers can study too.
speakerApps.nowSpeaker: This account is now a speaker account. They can apply to speak at /speaker.
speakerApps.editHint: You're editing the speaker's application. The decision doesn't change and the speaker isn't told. The public profile is edited on the speaker's page.

slots.title: Availability
slots.intro: Times speakers can book, in Cairo time. A session or podcast booking creates a draft session, a course booking a draft course, and the session team is emailed.

slots.previewNone: No future times match. Choose days and months.
slots.pickDate: Choose a date and a time.

slots.createCourseDraft: Create course draft from this booking
slots.courseDraftConfirm: Create a draft course from this booking? It's prefilled from the booking, with the speaker as instructor. The booking's draft session is removed; its Arabic title, description and cover carry over.
slots.courseDraftConfirmKeep: Create a draft course from this booking? It's prefilled from the booking, with the speaker as instructor. The booking's session stays as it is.
slots.courseDrafted: Course draft created. Open it to finish and publish it.
slots.courseAlready: This booking already has its course.
slots.releaseConfirmCourse: Release this booking? The slot opens again, the draft course is deleted, and the session team is told.
slots.releaseConfirmCourseKept: Release this booking? The slot opens again. Its course is already published ({status}), so it stays as it is: archive it in Courses if it shouldn't run. The session team is told.
slots.releasedCourseKept: Released. The course was already published, so it was kept: check it in Courses.

assessments.intro: Quizzes are graded automatically. Labs and assignments are graded here, with written feedback. Students see published assessments only.
assessments.none: No assessments yet. Add the first quiz, lab or assignment.

form.certificateOptionalHint: Graded and earns points, but doesn't affect the certificate.

Once students submit, max points, questions, weights and the key are locked; wording stays editable.

upload.title: Upload questions from Excel or CSV
upload.intro: One question per row. Download the template, fill it in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers, then upload it here (.xlsx or .csv, up to {max} questions).
upload.columns: Columns: type (single, multiple or true_false), question, option1 to option6, correct (an option number such as 2, several such as 1,3, letters such as B, or true/false), weight (the question’s points, a whole number from 1 to 100; 1 if empty. A question with weight 2 counts twice as much as one with weight 1) and explanation (optional).
upload.tooBig: That file is too big (5 MB max).
upload.badFile: That file couldn’t be read. Upload an .xlsx or .csv file (old .xls files: save them as .xlsx first).
upload.found: {count, plural, one {# question ready} other {# questions ready}}
upload.errorCount: {count, plural, one {# row needs fixing} other {# rows need fixing}}. Fix the file and upload it again.
upload.question: Question
upload.overLimit: A quiz can have at most {max} questions: this would make {total}.
upload.replaceConfirm: Replace the {count} current questions with the {next} from the file?
upload.applied: {count, plural, one {# question added} other {# questions added}}. Review them below, then save the assessment.
upload.lockedNote: Students have already submitted: changing the questions isn’t possible now, so the upload is off.

errors.MISSING_COLUMN: The first row needs a “{column}” column (use the template).
errors.TOO_MANY_QUESTIONS: Too many rows: at most {max} questions per upload.
errors.UNKNOWN_TYPE: Unknown type “{value}”: use single, multiple or true_false.
errors.BAD_CORRECT: “{value}” isn’t an option number or letter (for example 2, 1,3 or B).
errors.CORRECT_NOT_AN_OPTION: The correct answer is option {n}, but that option is empty.
errors.ONE_CORRECT: A single-choice question has exactly one correct answer (use the type “multiple” for more).
errors.BAD_TRUE_FALSE: A true/false answer must be true or false, not “{value}”.
errors.BAD_WEIGHT: The weight “{value}” must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.TOO_LONG: The {column} is too long ({max} characters max).
errors.INVALID: This row isn’t a valid question.

import.title: Import quizzes from a file
import.intro: One spreadsheet can hold several quizzes, each on its own session: one row per question. Up to {quizzes} quizzes and {questions} questions per file, .xlsx or .csv. Nothing is saved until you check the preview and press Import; then every quiz is saved at once, or none if something fails.
import.columnsQuiz: quiz: the quiz title (rows with the same title make one quiz). session: the session number, its position in this course (1, 2, 3…), or “course” or empty for a whole-course quiz.
import.columnsSettings: Optional quiz settings, read from each quiz’s first row: pass_percent (0–100, default 70), due (2026-11-20 18:00, Cairo time), attempts (0 = unlimited, default 1), time_limit_min (minutes), reveal (never, after_submit or after_due), mandatory (yes or no: counts toward the certificate), status (draft or published; default draft), max_points (default 100), instructions.
import.ready: {quizzes, plural, one {# quiz} other {# quizzes}} with {questions, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} ready. Check them below, then import.
import.replace: Replace existing quizzes with the same title
import.replaceHint: Off: a quiz whose title is already used by a quiz of the same session is skipped. On: that quiz’s settings and questions are replaced by the file’s (not possible once students have submitted it).
import.publishWarning: {count, plural, one {# quiz is} other {# quizzes are}} set to published: every enrolled student gets an in-app notice and an email for each, now. Set status to draft in the file to publish later.
import.nothingToSave: Every quiz in the file already exists in its session. Turn on “Replace” to update them.
import.save: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to import} one {Import # quiz} other {Import # quizzes}}
import.hasSubmissions: Students have submitted {titles}: those quizzes can’t be replaced. Rename them in the file, or turn off “Replace”. Nothing was saved.
import.dailyLimit: This would go over the daily limit on new assessments. Import fewer quizzes, or try again tomorrow. Nothing was saved.
import.sessionsChanged: The course’s sessions changed: reload the page and preview the file again. Nothing was saved.
import.tooLarge: The file is too large to import at once. Split it into two files. Nothing was saved.

errors.NO_QUIZ_TITLE: The “quiz” column is empty: name the quiz this question belongs to.
errors.BAD_TITLE: A quiz title is {min} to {max} characters.
errors.BAD_SESSION: “{value}” isn’t a session number: use 1, 2, 3… or “course”.
errors.SESSION_MISMATCH: This row says session “{value}”, but the quiz’s first row says “{first}”.
errors.BAD_PASS_PERCENT: The pass percent “{value}” must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
errors.BAD_DUE: “{value}” isn’t a date: write it like 2026-11-20 18:00 (Cairo time).
errors.BAD_TIME_LIMIT: The time limit “{value}” must be 1 to 600 minutes.
errors.BAD_REVEAL: Unknown reveal “{value}”: use never, after_submit or after_due.
errors.BAD_MANDATORY: Mandatory “{value}” must be yes or no.
errors.BAD_STATUS: Unknown status “{value}”: use draft or published.
errors.BAD_MAX_POINTS: Max points “{value}” must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.REVEAL_NEEDS_DUE: Answers shown after the due date need a due date.
errors.PRACTICE_CERTIFICATE: Unlimited attempts with answers after each one is a practice quiz: it can’t be mandatory.
errors.TOO_MANY_QUIZZES: The file has {count} quizzes: at most {max} per file. Split it.
errors.QUIZ_TOO_MANY_QUESTIONS: This quiz has {count} questions: at most {max} per quiz.
errors.TOO_MANY_QUESTIONS: The file has {count} questions: at most {max} per file. Split it.
errors.UNKNOWN_SESSION: This course has no session {n}. Add the session first, or fix the number.

points.pageIntro: Award community points in bulk from a CSV, and manage the badges. Award or adjust points for one student from their page (Students).
points.importHint: Columns: email, points, note, course (a course slug, or empty for community points that only count toward the student's total). Points can be negative. Preview first: nothing is saved until you apply.

points.previewSummary: {ok} rows ready, {errors} with errors, {points} points in total.

points.badgesHint: Automatic badges are awarded by the hourly job and the course rules. Manual badges are awarded from a student's page. An inactive badge is no longer awarded or shown on leaderboards.
points.codeHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. demo-day-winner. Can't change later.
points.boardHint: Everyone enrolled, ranked by points, including students who haven't opted into the public board (they are marked Hidden). Students only ever see opted-in classmates, by first name and last initial.
points.title: Points & badges
points.revokeConfirm: Remove the badge "{name}" from this student?
points.pointsHint: A whole number; negative to take points away.
points.noteHint: What the points are for, e.g. "Helped 5 people on Telegram". The student sees it.

settings.speakerPointsCap: Largest points entry a speaker can add, change or remove

points.importedBefore: This exact file was already imported on {date}. Importing it again adds the points a second time.

studentEdit.intro: Edit one step at a time. The same rules as the student's own form apply; leave an optional field empty to remove it. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

studentEdit.deleted: The account was deleted. It is anonymised after 30 days.

addStudent.title: Add a student
addStudent.intro: Creates a student account for this email address. Nobody sets a password for them: they get an email to choose their own (the link works for 7 days, then "Forgot password" does), and then complete their profile. To add them to a course, use "Add accepted emails" on Applications.
addStudent.name: Full name (optional)
addStudent.done: Account created for {email}. They've been emailed a link to choose their password.

speakerEdit.slugChanged: The page moves to /speakers/{new}. The old address /speakers/{old} keeps working: it redirects here.
speakerEdit.applicationHint: The application behind this profile: edit what they sent (contact details, referral, proposal).

speakerEdit.deleteAccountStays: Their speaker account stays. If their application was approved, it goes back to "Under review": approve it again to give them a new profile so they can keep booking.

acceptedEmails.title: Add accepted emails
acceptedEmails.intro: Enrol people you accepted outside the site, by email address. It's the course's Enrol-by-email tool: people with a confirmed student account are enrolled now, everyone else is invited and enrolled when they sign up.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your admin account doesn't include this part of the admin panel. Ask a super admin if you need it.
noAccess.none: Your admin account has no permissions yet. Ask a super admin to give you some.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Who can use the admin panel, and what each person can do. Changes apply at once, without signing anyone out.

media.title: Media

staff.intro: Who runs this course and what each role may do. Staff can be any academy account (a speaker, an admin, a student) and only reach this course, in the Teaching area. People in Shown roles are on the public course page; anonymous ones never are.
